title: How to Set Up Your First Wolt Ads Campaign in Greece - Wolt (Greece)

facts.fact: In Wolt's own 2025 global local commerce report, 81% of consumers who had ordered restaurant food said they discovered new venues on Wolt.
facts.quote: 81% of consumers who had ordered restaurant food said they discovered new venues on Wolt.

facts.fact: The Wolt 2025 global local commerce report study covered 23 markets across Europe and Asia.
facts.quote: The study covered 23 markets across Europe and Asia

facts.fact: Wolt states that Sponsored Listings use a pay-per-order model, so merchants pay only when a customer places a completed order through the ad.
facts.quote: Sponsored Listings use a pay-per-order model.

facts.fact: Wolt states that merchants are not charged for clicks or views that do not lead to a sale.
facts.quote: You are not charged for clicks or views that do not lead to a sale

facts.fact: Wolt states that merchants pay only for completed orders attributed to the ad when Wolt Ads are pay per order.
facts.quote: Because Wolt Ads are pay per order, you pay only for completed orders attributed to the ad.

facts.fact: Wolt states that Sponsored Listings can place a venue in top positions including the Discovery tab, search results, Restaurant and Store pages, and cart recommendations.
facts.quote: Sponsored Listings can place your venue in top positions across the Wolt app, including the Discovery tab, search results, Restaurant and Store pages, and cart recommendations.

facts.fact: Wolt states that Wolt Ads increase a venue's visibility without changing its menu, prices or ratings.
facts.quote: Wolt Ads increase your visibility without changing your menu, prices or ratings.

facts.fact: Wolt states there is no universal ideal duration for a first Wolt Ads campaign test period.
facts.quote: There is no universal ideal duration.

facts.fact: In the Wolt Merchant Portal, a new ad campaign is created by selecting Campaigns, then New campaign, then Ads and Get started.
facts.quote: Then select Campaigns in the left navigation and choose New campaign.

facts.fact: Wolt's Merchant Portal campaign report lists total sales, total spend, orders from Ads, return on ad spend, average cost per order and average order value.
facts.quote: open Campaigns and look at total sales, total spend, orders from Ads, return on ad spend, average cost per order and average order value.

facts.fact: Wolt states that a merchant may go temporarily offline during busy periods and return when ready.
facts.quote: If the kitchen becomes especially busy, you remain free to go temporarily offline and return when you are ready.
